status: prospective primary development plan, written before candidate scores
target: Positive units on completed or shipped transactions, normalized status; retain gross fulfilled units even if Return_Flag says Yes because return restockability and timing are unknown. Exclude returned/cancelled/processing statuses and nonpositive quantities. Deduplicate exact rows, reject conflicting transaction IDs.
population: Fixed supplied 336-pair operating roster, each must have been observed before origin; retrospective current-roster restriction disclosed. All channels attributed to supplied Store_ID; no evidence supports dropping online shipments.
missingness: No daily zero filling. Aggregate transactions directly to completed Monday-Sunday weeks. A week without any store transactions is unknown (NaN), not zero. Within a store-active week, absent product records mean zero recorded fulfilled units, conditional on extract completeness, not proof of zero demand or assortment. Exclude first partial week and training before 2023-04-03 to allow year lags and known roster. Features fill missing lags with available past averages, not missing target zeros.
training: Only transactions dated at or before each origin; regression target weeks from 2023-04-03 through origin. Observed final statuses lack historical change timestamps; comparisons conditional on exported statuses, not a true historical as-of simulation.

horizons.secondary: next fourteen days and exact per-pair lead time plus seven review days (8-14 days), using same origin weekly rate scaled by days; evaluate only store-active windows

baseline: previous complete calendar month pair fulfilled units / calendar days * 7; analytical baseline, not exact customer process

candidate_specifications.recent13: mean of last 13 complete eligible weeks per pair
candidate_specifications.seasonal_pool: 52-week pair mean times target-month pooled seasonality; month factors normalized for days and global rate using all preceding complete calendar years; cap factor to 0.5-2.0
candidate_specifications.ridge: Ridge alpha=100, lsqr, no hyperparameter search; product/store and forecast month indicators plus prior-week, 4/13/52-week means, year-lag week, and elapsed years; clip predictions to nonnegative; fit anew each origin

primary_metric: Mean absolute error in product units per product at store per next-week origin, equal weight to each eligible pair-origin; no prices or artificial cost weights. WAPE reported as equivalent scaled diagnostic.
selection_rule: Lowest pooled primary MAE. Numerical ties within 1e-8 choose baseline, then recent13, then seasonal_pool, then ridge. No invented meaningful business improvement threshold. Inspect horizon and origin sensitivity without changing selection rule.
secondary_diagnostics: gross target versus including processing or excluding returned-flag fulfilled rows
paired origin bootstrap error difference; descriptive development interval, only eight origins
compute: Record whole-process wall/CPU and peak RSS plus preparation/fitting/inference times, design matrix sizes and retained data. CPU-only ordinary 8 GB suitability must be workload-backed, no host-RAM assumption.
information_boundary: No December sales files or outcomes. Supplied future arrival dates are operational known-as-of inputs. Current stock/rules never enter historical forecast fitting or historical business-cost scoring.
performance_success_recording: Not ready: development data already inspected, no independent untouched evaluation or externally predeclared meaningful improvement threshold. No threshold invented.
